summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are eating at a restaurant. At the same moment, in the restaurant's private room, a company is having dissolution party. But after giving a speech, the company president, Jiro Kureno falls dead onto the floor. Location: Restaurant private dining room Cause of death: Poison needle Suspects: Junnosuke Toda, Hiroo Kamijou, Eiji Koshimoto, and Mayu Narita After receiving rose bouquet, Jiro suddenly feeling pain, before collapse onto the floor.The murder weapon was a needle with poison in the rose bouquet. After the interrogatory, Eiji Koshimoto, merchandise manager and former college of the president went to the toilet, but he did not come back. Later, a waitress finds Koshimoto strangled with a suicide note in his body. Location: Restaurant storage room Victim: Eiji Koshimoto Cause of death: Strangulation
